;Business and economy
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**The U.S. [[Federal Communications Commission]] (FCC) unanimously votes to label Chinese telecommunications giants [[Huawei]] and [[ZTE]] as national security risks, thereby disqualifying them from the [[Universal Service Fund]]. In a separate vote, the FCC mandates that [[List of United States wireless communications service providers|national wireless carriers]] remove both companies' products from their existing networks. The companies have 30 days to appeal. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-huawei-tech/fcc-votes-5-0-to-bar-chinas-huawei-zte-from-government-subsidy-program-idUSKBN1XW1TC (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Japan–South Korea trade dispute]]
**[[South Korea]] halts its [[World Trade Organization]] complaint concerning [[Japan]]'s tightened export controls of key chemicals South Korea uses for [[computer chip]]s and displays. [https://www.voanews.com/east-asia-pacific/south-korea-reverses-course-will-still-share-intel-japan (Voice of America)]
*[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] files a lawsuit against the [[United States Department of Defense]] for awarding a [[U.S. dollar|US$]]10 billion [[cloud computing]] contract to [[Microsoft]]. The company had previously accused the Department of bias in their decision, given CEO [[Jeff Bezos]] has been a vocal critic of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-amazon-com-pentagon-microsoft/amazon-files-lawsuit-contesting-pentagons-10-billion-cloud-contract-to-microsoft-idUSKBN1XX00M?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**[[Samoa]] confirms that 20 persons, all but one under the age of four, have died of [[measles]], and 11 more are in critical condition. Authorities recorded 1,644 cases since the outbreak began last month. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/403902/samoa-measles-death-toll-hits-20-eleven-children-critical (RNZ)]

;International relations
*[[Chagos Archipelago sovereignty dispute]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] misses a [[United Nations]] deadline to return control of the disputed [[Chagos Archipelago]] to [[Mauritius]], prompting the [[government of Mauritius]] to call the UK an "illegal [[colonialism|colonial occupier]]". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-50511847 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Murder of Grace Millane]]
** After a three-week trial, a 27-year-old New Zealand man is found guilty of murdering 22-year-old British tourist Grace Millane in [[Auckland]] in December 2018. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-essex-50512163 (BBC News)]
*Former [[Paraguay]]an [[Congress of Paraguay|Congresswoman]] [[Cynthia Tarragó]] is arrested alongside her husband at [[Newark Liberty International Airport]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]] and charged with [[money laundering]], following an undercover operation from [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] agents who purported to be drug traffickers. According to court documents, in addition to money laudering, Tarragó offered to [[Illegal drug trade|traffic drugs]] herself from Paraguay. [https://www.abc.com.py/tv/abc-noticias/2019/11/22/detienen-a-cynthia-tarrago-en-eeuu/ (''ABC Color'')] [https://www.ultimahora.com/detienen-cynthia-tarrago-eeuu-blanqueo-dinero-n2856211.html (''Última Hora'')] [https://www.inquirer.com/business/money-laundering-cocaine-marijuana-paraguay-newark-cynthia-tarrago-diaz-raimundo-va-fbu-20191122.html (''The Philadelphia Inquirer'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Next German federal election|2021 German federal election]]
**[[Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer]], who replaced [[Chancellor of Germany|German Chancellor]] [[Angela Merkel]] as leader of the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|Christian Democratic Union]], threatens to stand down as a chancellor candidate if her [[centre-right]] party continues to disagree over support. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-50520902 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/22/merkel-successor-annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-back-her-or-sack-her (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/11/22/mini-merkel-faces-critics-back-sack-challenge/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[2019 Bolivian protests]], [[2019 Bolivian political crisis]]
**[[Bolivia]]'s new [[interior minister]], Arturo Murillo, files a criminal complaint against former [[President of Bolivia|President]] [[Evo Morales]] for alleged [[sedition]] and [[terrorism]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/22/bolivia-evo-morales-terrorism-sedition-interim-government (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bolivia-politics/bolivias-interim-government-charges-morales-with-sedition-and-terrorism-idUSKBN1XW26Y (Reuters)]
